description: Vertex Pharmaceuticals provides funding for Investigator-Initiated Research (IIR) and Medical Education Grants. They accept requests for proposals for both categories, with specific focus areas related to their therapeutic areas.

Biogen offers various funding opportunities, including independent medical education grants and investigator-initiated research grants. They issue requests for proposals (RFPs) in areas of strategic interest.

Alexion provides grants and funding for independent medical education and investigator-initiated research, with specific calls for proposals (RFPs) and application processes detailed on their website.
Horizon Therapeutics offers independent medical education grants and investigator-initiated research grants, with an application process that involves submitting proposals.

Regeneron provides funding for independent medical education and investigator-initiated research, outlining specific therapeutic areas of interest for their grant programs and often issuing calls for proposals.
Sage Therapeutics supports independent medical education and investigator-initiated research through grants and funding opportunities, with details on how to submit a proposal or apply for funding.
Intercept Pharmaceuticals offers independent medical education grants and supports investigator-initiated research, providing information on their website for interested parties to submit proposals.
Moderna provides funding opportunities through grants and fellowships, and periodically issues calls for proposals (CFP) for research aligned with their strategic priorities in mRNA science.
Ionis Pharmaceuticals supports independent medical education and investigator-initiated research through grants, with specific guidelines and an application process for submitting proposals.
Jazz Pharmaceuticals provides funding for Investigator-Initiated Research (IIR) and Independent Medical Education (IME), with a process for submitting proposals and applying for grants.
